# Atmosphere Input and Output Feeding gases into and extracting them from an existing atmosphere or a vacuum is an important part of an atmospheric technician's job.
Using these devices, an atmospheric technician can supply, extract, or scrub unwanted gases from any atmosphere. This makes it possible to maintain a safe, breathable atmosphere.
Some of these devices require [textlink="power" link="Power"] to operate and can be linked to an [textlink="air alarm" link="AirAlarms"].
[textlink="Linking" link="Networking"] compatible devices to an air alarm enables additional settings and functions. Otherwise, these devices operate in their default mode as described in the subsections.
